<template>
  <v-app>
    <template v-if="isAuthenticated">
      <v-navigation-drawer
        v-model="drawer"
        :rail="rail"
        permanent
        @click="rail = false"
      >
        <v-list-item
          prepend-avatar="https://randomuser.me/api/portraits/men/85.jpg"
          :title="user.username"
          :subtitle="user.email"
        >
          <template v-slot:append>
            <v-btn
              variant="text"
              icon="mdi-chevron-left"
              @click.stop="rail = !rail"
            ></v-btn>
          </template>
        </v-list-item>

        <v-divider></v-divider>

        <v-list density="compact" nav>
          <v-list-item
            prepend-icon="mdi-view-dashboard"
            title="Dashboard"
            value="dashboard"
            to="/dashboard"
          ></v-list-item>
          <v-list-item
            prepend-icon="mdi-format-list-checks"
            title="Open Positions"
            value="open"
            to="/open-positions"
          ></v-list-item>
          <v-list-item
            prepend-icon="mdi-format-list-text"
            title="Closed Positions"
            value="closed"
            to="/closed-positions"
          ></v-list-item>
          <v-list-item
            prepend-icon="mdi-swap-horizontal"
            title="Transactions"
            value="transactions"
            to="/transactions"
          ></v-list-item>
          <v-list-item
            prepend-icon="mdi-database"
            title="Database"
            value="database"
            @click="toggleDatabaseMenu"
          ></v-list-item>
        </v-list>

        <v-list v-if="showDatabaseMenu" density="compact" nav>
          <v-list-item
            prepend-icon="mdi-bank"
            title="Brokers"
            value="brokers"
            to="/database/brokers"
          ></v-list-item>
          <v-list-item
            prepend-icon="mdi-file-document-outline"
            title="Securities"
            value="securities"
            to="/database/securities"
          ></v-list-item>
          <v-list-item
            prepend-icon="mdi-chart-line"
            title="Prices"
            value="prices"
            to="/database/prices"
          ></v-list-item>
        </v-list>

        <template v-slot:append>
          <v-list density="compact" nav>
            <v-list-item
              prepend-icon="mdi-account"
              title="Profile"
              value="profile"
              to="/profile"
            ></v-list-item>
            <v-list-item
              prepend-icon="mdi-logout"
              title="Logout"
              value="logout"
              @click="logout"
            ></v-list-item>
          </v-list>
        </template>
      </v-navigation-drawer>

      <v-main>
        <v-container fluid>
          <router-view></router-view>
        </v-container>
      </v-main>
    </template>
    
    <template v-else>
      <v-main>
        <v-container fluid>
          <router-view></router-view>
        </v-container>
      </v-main>
    </template>
  </v-app>
</template>

<script>
import { inject, computed, onMounted, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'

export default {
  setup() {
    const user = inject('user')
    const fetchUserData = inject('fetchUserData')
    const router = useRouter()

    const isAuthenticated = computed(() => !!user.value)

    const logout = () => {
      localStorage.removeItem('token')
      user.value = null
      router.push('/login')
    }

    onMounted(fetchUserData)

    watch(() => router.currentRoute.value, fetchUserData)

    return {
      user,
      isAuthenticated,
      logout,
      drawer: true,
      rail: true,
      showDatabaseMenu: false,
      toggleDatabaseMenu() {
        this.showDatabaseMenu = !this.showDatabaseMenu
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>
